svg.title: TransformerBlock.forward and the residual stream
svg.desc: A vertical residual stream runs from the layer input at the bottom to the output at the top. Two side branches tap it: RMSNorm then attention, added back at the first plus; then RMSNorm then SwiGLU, added back at the second plus.
svg.text: Thick line = residual stream · branches read a normalized copy and add their result back
